hint: You're offline. Pages you opened before can still be read and edited; changes sync when the connection is back.
signOutUnsynced: Some pages have edits that haven't reached the server yet. Signing out removes them from this browser. Sign out anyway?

page.heading: You're offline
page.body: Leafdesk can't reach the server right now. Pages you opened on this device are listed below and open from this browser's copy.
page.empty: No pages are saved on this device yet. Pages you open while online are kept for offline use.

stale.title: Leafdesk has been updated
stale.body: This tab still runs the previous version, so its pages have stopped syncing. Reload to continue. Edits you made here are kept and sent after the reload.
stale.offlineBody: This tab runs a different version than the one this browser last used, so its pages have stopped syncing. Reload once you're back online. Edits you made here are kept and sent then.
